summary: Completed testing of Portal Payment (Stripe) feature. All backend APIs (11/11 tests passed) and frontend UI working correctly. Pay button appears on unpaid factures with amount > 0, correctly hidden for 0€ factures, and redirects to Stripe checkout.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/portal/facture/{id}/pay correctly creates Stripe checkout session and returns URL
Payment endpoint correctly rejects factures with 0€ amount (returns 400 'Aucun montant à payer')
Payment endpoint correctly rejects already paid factures (statut='payee')
Payment endpoint requires valid client portal token (returns 401 for invalid token)
GET /api/portal/facture/{id}/payment-status correctly checks payment status via Stripe API
Stripe is configured in TEST mode (session_id starts with cs_test_)
Frontend Pay button shows amount due (e.g., 'Payer 120,00 €')
Frontend correctly hides Pay button for 0€ factures (F2026-00006)
Frontend correctly hides Pay button for already paid factures
Pay button click successfully redirects to Stripe checkout page
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Used existing test factures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portal Payment (Stripe) feature fully tested. Key findings: 1) POST /api/portal/facture/{id}/pay creates Stripe checkout session and returns URL, 2) Payment endpoint rejects 0€ factures with 400 error, 3) Stripe is in TEST mode (sk_test_emergent key), 4) Frontend Pay button shows amount and redirects to Stripe checkout, 5) F2026-00006 (0€) correctly has no Pay button. Test factures: F2026-00005 (120€), F2026-00004 (300€), F2026-00001 (180€), F2026-00006 (0€).
